Register Newborn.description: Registers a newborn with NIA and mints a Ghana Card PIN, vouched for by a relative.

Get Minted PIN From Registration.description: Reads the baby and voucher Ghana Card PINs from a registration response (the adaptor cannot look registrations up).

Collect Minted PINs For A Batch.description: Registers a batch of newborns and collects the minted PINs, e.g. to reconcile with the eTracker (the adaptor cannot list registrations).
